Breadcrumb Home Data and Reports by Topic Immigration Naturalizations Profiles on Naturalized Citizens Data and Reports by Topic Immigration Yearbook of Immigration Statistics Lawful Permanent Residents Refugees Asylees Naturalizations Profiles on Naturalized Citizens Annual Flow Report Legal Immigration and Adjustment of Status Report Nonimmigrant Admissions (Temporary Visitors) Illegal Aliens Immigration Enforcement State Immigration Data Archive Law Enforcement Emergency Management Maritime International Trade Cybersecurity Infrastructure Protection Screening Profiles on Naturalized Citizens On This Page: Profiles by Country of Birth | Profiles by State of Residence | Profiles by Core Based Statistical Area (CBSA) | Profiles by Metropolitan Statistical Area (MSA) Naturalized citizens are foreign nationals who have become citizens of the United States after fulfilling requirements established by Congress in the Immigration and Nationality Act.We have profiles of people who became lawful permanent residents during each fiscal year from 2003-2022. Profiles are available by country of birth, state of residence, and core based statistical area (CBSA) of residence.As some terminology in reports do change, we maintain previously posted reports and datasets as originally approved and published.
